title: Use Seedance 2.0 instead of 2.5 when you need subtle facial expressions…
content: Use Seedance 2.0 instead of 2.5 when you need subtle facial expressions, emotional performance, or nuanced voice acting.
tips: Use Seedance 2.0 instead of 2.5 when you need subtle facial expressions, emotional performance, or nuanced voice acting.

es.content: Usa Seedance 2.0 en lugar de 2.5 cuando necesites expresiones faciales sutiles, interpretación emocional o actuación de voz matizada.

fr.content: Utilisez Seedance 2.0 plutôt que 2.5 lorsque vous avez besoin d’expressions faciales subtiles, d’une performance émotionnelle ou d’un jeu vocal nuancé.

ja.content: 繊細な表情、感情表現、またはニュアンスのある音声演技が必要な場合は、Seedance 2.5 ではなく Seedance 2.0 を使用してください。

ko.content: 미묘한 표정, 감정 연기, 또는 섬세한 성우 연기가 필요할 때는 2.5 대신 Seedance 2.0을 사용하세요.

pt.content: Use o Seedance 2.0 em vez do 2.5 quando você precisar de expressões faciais sutis, performance emocional ou atuação vocal com nuances.

zh.content: 当你需要细腻的面部表情、情感表演或微妙的配音演绎时，请使用 Seedance 2.0，而不是 2.5。
